answer: The prism index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the zephyr queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1254 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ledge. Bonded capital sits idle for 16 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
